label: Home mortgages, one to four family
tracing_rule: Serviced from household income. The labour backing share is the share of mortgage service paid by households with an employed member aged 25 to 64.

label: Revolving consumer credit
tracing_rule: Serviced from household income. The labour backing share is the working-core share of card balances in SIPP.

label: Consumer credit, automobile loans
tracing_rule: Serviced from household income. The labour backing share is the working-core share of vehicle loan balances in SIPP.

label: Consumer credit, student loans
tracing_rule: Serviced from household income. The labour backing share is the working-core share of student loan balances in SIPP.

label: Other non-revolving consumer credit
tracing_rule: Serviced from household income. No separate survey measure exists for this residual, so it carries the balance-weighted mean of the card, auto and student working-core shares. FLAGGED as a proxy.

label: Multifamily residential mortgages
tracing_rule: Serviced from rent. The labour backing share is the share of rent paid by working-core households. One intermediary, tenant to landlord to lender.

label: Treasury securities
tracing_rule: Serviced from federal receipts. The labour backing share is the labour-linked share of those receipts: social insurance contributions in full plus the wage share of the individual income tax.

label: State and local government debt
tracing_rule: Serviced from state and local receipts. The labour backing share is the wage share of personal current taxes over total state and local tax receipts. Property tax is a capital levy and sales tax is a second-round channel.

label: Corporate bonds, nonfinancial corporate
tracing_rule: Serviced from business revenue. Direct labour backing is ZERO BY RULE: the cash flow that services the claim is corporate operating cash flow and not wages. Labour reaches it only through demand, which is B2.

label: Corporate loans, nonfinancial corporate
tracing_rule: Serviced from business revenue. ZERO BY RULE, as for corporate bonds.

label: Nonfinancial noncorporate business loans
tracing_rule: Serviced from business revenue. ZERO BY RULE. FLAGGED: proprietors' income is mixed labour and capital by construction, so this is the class where the zero rule is least comfortable.

label: Commercial mortgages, excluding multifamily
tracing_rule: Serviced from business revenue, that is from commercial rent paid out of tenant business revenue. ZERO BY RULE. Multifamily is the exception and is a separate class because its rent is paid out of wages directly.

label: Corporate equities, nonfinancial corporate
tracing_rule: A residual claim on business revenue. ZERO BY RULE, and more so than debt: the residual claimant is paid after every contractual claim including wages.
